title: 19. Câu bị động với modal

intro.text: Bài 19 — Câu bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu (modal + be + V3). Làm câu hỏi ngay sau mỗi phần, mở toggle để kiểm tra. Cuối bài có Mini Test 16 câu.
Trọng tâm TOEIC: Part 5 hỏi 'modal + be + V3' (can be done) và 'modal + have been + V3' (should have been done) cho quá khứ.

knowledge.text: Khi câu bị động có động từ khuyết thiếu (modal), công thức là: modal + be + V3. Modal giữ nguyên, thêm 'be' (nguyên thể) rồi quá khứ phân từ. Rất phổ biến trong quy định, hướng dẫn: 'must be submitted', 'should be reviewed', 'can be done'.

rows: Forms must be signed by both parties.
The draft should be reviewed first.
You will be notified by email.
The form has to be completed today.
The device needs to be inspected.

items: Phủ định: modal + not + be + V3 — The data must not be shared.
Nghi vấn: Modal + S + be + V3? — Can the meeting be rescheduled?

knowledge.text: 4. Modal hoàn thành bị động (mở rộng)

modal + have been + V3 diễn tả bị động trong quá khứ/suy đoán: The package should have been delivered yesterday. (lẽ ra đã phải được giao). The error must have been overlooked. (chắc hẳn đã bị bỏ sót).
Cấu trúc rút gọn: 'need + V-ing' mang nghĩa bị động, tương đương 'need to be + V3': The printer needs repairing = The printer needs to be repaired. (cần được sửa).

(1) Phải có 'be' giữa modal và V3: should BE reviewed (sai 'should reviewed'). (2) Sau modal là 'be' nguyên thể, không chia (must be, không 'must is'). (3) Dùng V3 (cột 3), không V2/V-ing: can be done (không 'can be did/doing'). (4) modal + have been + V3 cho bị động quá khứ.

parts.heading: Phần 1 · modal + be + V3
theory: Bị động với modal: can/should/must/will/may + be + V3. Chủ ngữ nhận hành động.
keys: can be submitted, must be completed, should be accompanied, will be delivered, may be released.
traps: Sau 'modal + be' luôn là V3: 'can be solved' (không 'can be solve').
examples: The form can be submitted online.
The report must be completed by Friday.

questions.q:
The registration form ___ submitted online.
A. can be    B. can    C. can being    D. can to be
questions.a: Đáp án: A (can be). ||modal + be + V3 (can be submitted).

questions.q:
The audit report ___ completed by Friday at the latest.
A. must be    B. must    C. must being    D. must been
questions.a: Đáp án: A (must be). ||must + be + V3.

questions.q:
All visitors ___ accompanied by a staff member at all times.
A. should be    B. should    C. should being    D. should been
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should be). ||should + be + V3.

questions.q:
The replacement parts ___ delivered tomorrow.
A. will be    B. will    C. will being    D. will been
questions.a: Đáp án: A (will be). ||will + be + V3.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"The technical issue can be solve quickly."
questions.a: Lỗi: "can be solve" → "can be solved". ||Sau 'can be' dùng V3.

questions.q:
Confidential data ___ shared without written permission.
A. must not be    B. must be not    C. must not    D. mustn't being
questions.a: Đáp án: A (must not be). ||must not + be + V3 (must not be shared).

questions.q:
The official results ___ released later this week.
A. may be    B. may    C. may being    D. may been
questions.a: Đáp án: A (may be). ||may + be + V3.

questions.q:
Điền vào chính sách (Part 6):
"Refunds ___ processed within five business days."
A. can be    B. can    C. can being    D. can to be
questions.a: Đáp án: A (can be). ||can + be + V3.

parts.heading: Phần 2 · modal + have been + V3 (quá khứ)
theory: Để nói về quá khứ ở dạng bị động với modal, dùng modal + have been + V3.
keys: could have been avoided, must have been shredded, should have been finished, might have been delivered.
traps: Sau 'have been' dùng V3: 'should have been finished' (không 'should have been finish').

questions.q:
The costly error ___ avoided with better planning.
A. could have been    B. could been    C. could have    D. could be
questions.a: Đáp án: A (could have been). ||could have been + V3 = lẽ ra đã có thể (quá khứ bị động).

questions.q:
The documents are missing; they ___ shredded by mistake.
A. must have been    B. must been    C. must have    D. must be
questions.a: Đáp án: A (must have been). ||Suy đoán quá khứ bị động: must have been + V3.

questions.q:
The project ___ completed on time if we had had more staff.
A. could have been    B. could be    C. could been    D. could have
questions.a: Đáp án: A (could have been). ||could have been + V3 (điều kiện không có thật trong quá khứ).

questions.q:
The package ___ delivered to the wrong address last week.
A. might have been    B. might been    C. might be    D. might have
questions.a: Đáp án: A (might have been). ||Suy đoán quá khứ bị động: might have been + V3.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"The report should have been finish earlier."
questions.a: Lỗi: "been finish" → "been finished". ||Sau have been dùng V3.

questions.q:
The decision ___ made without consulting the whole team.
A. shouldn't have been    B. shouldn't been    C. shouldn't be    D. shouldn't have
questions.a: Đáp án: A (shouldn't have been). ||shouldn't have been + V3 = lẽ ra không nên (quá khứ).

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. The files should been backed up before the crash.
B. The files should have been backed up before the crash.
C. The files should have backed up before the crash.
D. The files should having been backed up.
questions.a: Đáp án: B. ||should have been + V3.

questions.q:
Điền vào đánh giá (Part 6):
"The defect ___ have been detected during quality control."
A. should    B. should not    C. could not    D. would not
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||should have been detected = lẽ ra nên được phát hiện.

parts.heading: Phần 3 · have to be / be going to be / need to be
theory: Các cấu trúc bán-modal cũng tạo bị động: have to be + V3, be going to be + V3, need to be + V3, used to be + V3.
keys: has/have to be reviewed; is going to be upgraded; needs to be serviced; used to be stored.
traps: 'needs to be serviced' (không 'needs to be service'); 'has to be signed' (không 'has to be sign').

questions.q:
The contract ___ to be reviewed by the legal team.
A. has    B. has being    C. having    D. have been
questions.a: Đáp án: A (has). ||has to be + V3 (reviewed).

questions.q:
The accounting system ___ going to be upgraded next month.
A. is    B. is being    C. has    D. will
questions.a: Đáp án: A (is). ||is going to be + V3 (upgraded).

questions.q:
The equipment needs ___ serviced at regular intervals.
A. to be    B. being    C. be    D. been
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to be). ||need to be + V3.

questions.q:
The old records used ___ stored in the basement.
A. to be    B. being    C. be    D. been
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to be). ||used to be + V3 (stored).

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"The form has to be sign by a manager."
questions.a: Lỗi: "be sign" → "be signed". ||has to be + V3.

questions.q:
The funding proposal ___ to be approved before any spending.
A. has    B. has being    C. having    D. have been
questions.a: Đáp án: A (has). ||has to be + V3 (approved).

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. The machine needs being repaired urgently.
B. The machine needs to be repaired urgently.
C. The machine needs be repaired urgently.
D. The machine needs repair to be urgently.
questions.a: Đáp án: B. ||need to be + V3 (repaired).

questions.q:
Điền vào quy trình (Part 6):
"All invoices ___ to be verified before payment is released."
A. have    B. have being    C. having    D. has been
questions.a: Đáp án: A (have). ||'invoices' số nhiều → have to be + V3.

parts.heading: Phần 4 · Phủ định và make/let ở bị động
theory: Phủ định: cannot/must not/may not + be + V3. Động từ 'make' ở bị động dùng be made TO V (khác chủ động make sb V trần).
keys: cannot be accessed, must not be shut down, may not be connected. The workers were made to redo the task.
traps: make ở bị động phải có 'to': 'were made to leave' (không 'were made leave').

questions.q:
Confidential files ___ accessed by unauthorized staff.
A. cannot    B. cannot be    C. can be not    D. cannot being
questions.a: Đáp án: B (cannot be). ||cannot + be + V3 (accessed).

questions.q:
Due to the policy, the workers ___ made to redo the safety drill.
A. were    B. were being    C. was    D. been
questions.a: Đáp án: A (were). ||make ở bị động: were made to + V.

questions.q:
Once finalized, the decision ___ reversed at this stage.
A. can not    B. cannot be    C. can be not    D. cannot
questions.a: Đáp án: B (cannot be). ||cannot + be + V3 (reversed).

questions.q:
Full-time staff ___ allowed to leave early on Fridays.
A. are    B. are being    C. is    D. been
questions.a: Đáp án: A (are). ||be allowed to + V (are allowed to).

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"The visitors were made leave the building immediately."
questions.a: Lỗi: "made leave" → "made to leave". ||make ở bị động dùng 'to + V'.

questions.q:
The main server ___ shut down during business hours.
A. must    B. must not be    C. must be not    D. mustn't being
questions.a: Đáp án: B (must not be). ||must not + be + V3 (shut down).

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. Employees is encouraged to share ideas.
B. Employees are encouraged to share ideas.
C. Employees being encouraged to share ideas.
D. Employees been encouraged to share ideas.
questions.a: Đáp án: B. ||be encouraged to + V (are encouraged to).

questions.q:
Điền vào nội quy IT (Part 6):
"Personal devices ___ connected to the company network."
A. may    B. may not be    C. may be not    D. may not
questions.a: Đáp án: B (may not be). ||may not + be + V3 (connected).

parts.heading: Phần 5 · Luyện trộn nhanh (10 câu)
theory: Trộn modal + be + V3, modal + have been + V3, have to be, và phủ định.

questions.q:
The application ___ submitted before the deadline.
A. must be    B. must    C. must being    D. must been
questions.a: Đáp án: A (must be). ||must + be + V3.

questions.q:
That costly mistake ___ caught earlier during review.
A. could    B. could have been    C. could been    D. could be
questions.a: Đáp án: B (could have been). ||could have been + V3 (quá khứ).

questions.q:
The contract ___ to be signed by both parties.
A. has    B. has being    C. having    D. have been
questions.a: Đáp án: A (has). ||has to be + V3 (signed).

questions.q:
Sensitive data ___ stored on personal devices.
A. must not be    B. must be not    C. must not    D. mustn't being
questions.a: Đáp án: A (must not be). ||must not + be + V3.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"The order can be cancel within 24 hours."
questions.a: Lỗi: "be cancel" → "be cancelled". ||Sau 'can be' dùng V3.

questions.q:
The whole building ___ going to be inspected next week.
A. is    B. is being    C. has    D. will
questions.a: Đáp án: A (is). ||is going to be + V3 (inspected).

questions.q:
The report ___ reviewed before it was released.
A. should    B. should have been    C. should been    D. should be
questions.a: Đáp án: B (should have been). ||should have been + V3 (quá khứ bị động).

questions.q:
The equipment needs ___ calibrated every month.
A. to be    B. being    C. be    D. been
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to be). ||need to be + V3.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. Visitors is required to wear badges.
B. Visitors are required to wear badges.
C. Visitors being required to wear badges.
D. Visitors been required to wear badges.
questions.a: Đáp án: B. ||be required to + V (are required to).

questions.q:
Điền vào cảnh báo (Part 6):
"The defective units ___ have been removed from the shelves immediately."
A. should    B. should not    C. could not    D. would not
questions.a: Đáp án: A (should). ||should have been removed = lẽ ra nên được gỡ bỏ ngay.

minitest.heading: 🏋️ Bài luyện tập tổng hợp (Mini Test · 16 câu)
minitest.note: Làm liên tục 16 câu, gợi ý 8–10 phút, KHÔNG mở đáp án giữa chừng. Mục tiêu: đúng từ 13/16 trở lên.

questions.q:
The registration form ___ completed online or in person.
A. can be    B. can    C. can being    D. can to be
questions.a: A (can be). ||can + be + V3.

questions.q:
The shipment ___ delivered no later than Thursday.
A. will be    B. will    C. will being    D. will been
questions.a: A (will be). ||will + be + V3.

questions.q:
The error ___ prevented with a final quality check.
A. could    B. could have been    C. could been    D. could be
questions.a: B (could have been). ||could have been + V3 (quá khứ).

questions.q:
Confidential documents ___ left unattended on desks.
A. must not be    B. must be not    C. must not    D. mustn't being
questions.a: A (must not be). ||must not + be + V3.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"The proposal should have been submit last week."
questions.a: Lỗi: "been submit" → "been submitted". ||Sau have been dùng V3.

questions.q:
The contract ___ to be reviewed by the legal department.
A. has    B. has being    C. having    D. have been
questions.a: A (has). ||has to be + V3.

questions.q:
The secure system ___ accessed without a valid password.
A. can not    B. cannot be    C. can be not    D. cannot
questions.a: B (cannot be). ||cannot + be + V3.

questions.q:
The machine needs ___ serviced before the next shift.
A. to be    B. being    C. be    D. been
questions.a: A (to be). ||need to be + V3.

questions.q:
The decision ___ made far more carefully.
A. should    B. should have been    C. should been    D. should be
questions.a: B (should have been). ||should have been + V3 (quá khứ).

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. Staff is allowed to work remotely twice a week.
B. Staff are allowed to work remotely twice a week.
C. Staff being allowed to work remotely.
D. Staff been allowed to work remotely.
questions.a: B. ||be allowed to + V (are allowed to).

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"The workers were made redo the entire safety drill."
questions.a: Lỗi: "made redo" → "made to redo". ||make ở bị động dùng 'to + V'.

questions.q:
All payments ___ to be approved by a supervisor.
A. have    B. has being    C. having    D. has been
questions.a: A (have). ||'payments' số nhiều → have to be + V3.

questions.q:
The data ___ backed up before the system upgrade.
A. should    B. should have been    C. should been    D. should be
questions.a: B (should have been). ||should have been + V3 (quá khứ).

questions.q:
The new software ___ installed on all computers next week.
A. will be    B. will    C. will being    D. will been
questions.a: A (will be). ||will + be + V3.

questions.q:
Personal phones ___ used during client meetings.
A. should not be    B. should be not    C. should not    D. shouldn't being
questions.a: A (should not be). ||should not + be + V3.

questions.q:
Điền vào quy trình (Part 6):
"Returned items ___ inspected before a refund is issued."
A. must be    B. must    C. must being    D. must been
questions.a: A (must be). ||must + be + V3.

summary: Bị động với modal: modal + be + V3 (can be done, should be done, must be done, will be done, may be done).
Bị động hoàn thành với modal: modal + have been + V3 (should/must/could/might have been done) — diễn tả quá khứ.
have to be / be going to be / need to be / used to be + V3.
Phủ định: cannot be done, must not be done, may not be done. 'make' ở bị động dùng be made TO V.

summary_callouts.text: Bẫy: modal + be + V3 (be reviewed, không 'be review'); quá khứ dùng modal + have been + V3 (should have been finished, không 'should have been finish'). make bị động: be made TO V.
Sau khi làm xong: nếu đúng dưới 13/16, đổi Trạng thái bài thành "Cần ôn" và làm lại Phần 2 (modal + have been + V3) sau 1 ngày.
